subject.title: fix(gateway): bound BOOT.md file read size

question: Should a present `BOOT.md` over 16 MiB be treated as empty and skipped, or surfaced as an explicit boot-check failure?
rationale: Both choices prevent unbounded allocation, but they differ in compatibility and operator visibility; repository tests cannot select that product behavior.

options.title: Accept skipped oversized files
options.body: Keep the current patch, treating the 16 MiB threshold as a safety boundary whose overflow skips BOOT execution.

options.title: Fail with a size-limit reason
options.body: Preserve visibility for existing oversized files by returning an explicit failed boot outcome without reading the full file.

recommendation.title: Accept skipped oversized files
recommendation.body: Keep the current patch, treating the 16 MiB threshold as a safety boundary whose overflow skips BOOT execution.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged per-agent BOOT startup implementation is the closest feature-history ownership signal for this behavior choice.
